book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book informs concepts and teaching structure; notes, numerical examples and short checks are independently written. No textbook exercises or artwork are copied.

syllabus.version_note: Official syllabus URLs for 2026-2027 and 2028-2030 were checked. Section 5.4 on printed page 35 was visually compared. On the final fetch, the 2026-2027 screenshot cover and change log say Version 4, while extracted web text says Version 5; no unqualified latest-version assertion is made. The 2028-2030 cover says Version 1.
excluded: negative-binomial formula as a required theorem

conventions.probability_rounding: Probabilities and expectations to 3 significant figures unless an exact answer is requested; parameters and integer bounds exact
conventions.working: Show sufficient working; retain unrounded intermediate probabilities.

sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only; written explanations, model assumptions, integer bounds, stopped histories and method marks use the existing manual/teacher workflow.
